sections.content:
Wait — the action history only shows 8 DOWNs (the batch was 9 DOWN + 3 LEFT + SPACE = 13 actions, but the history displays "DOWN×8" as the last 10 actions... it says "executed actions (first 10): DOWN×8" — hmm, it's truncated). Current W is at (45,27)?? Expected X center after 9 DOWN from 21: 21+27=48 → (48,27), then 3 LEFT → (48,18). But W is at (45,27), and X's hrow/vcol aren't found (the X's arms may have shifted). Also, the image shows the X at around (45,27)?? In the image, the X center is around (45,27), with the diamond at (30,38) and the blue cross at (42,48).
Hmm, W (45,27): the X center is at (45,27), not (48,18). So the batch was partially executed? The history shows only 8 actions: DOWN×8? "Executed actions (first 10): DOWN, DOWN, DOWN, DOWN, DOWN, DOWN, DOWN, DOWN" — 8 actions listed. So the batch was cut off after 8 DOWNs? 21+24=45 → (45,27) ✓. So the batch stopped after 8 DOWNs — maybe the 9th DOWN was blocked (clamp at the edge? No, 45+3=48 < 64). Or the action list was truncated... or a collision: X at (45,27) — moving DOWN to (48,27): X's arm reaches (48+11, 27+11)=(59,38)... blue dot (48,33)? X's diagonal from (48,27): (48-k,27+k) and (48+k,27-k)... the arm passes near the blue dot (48,33)? Not exactly on it.
Wait, maybe the 9th DOWN was blocked by the blue cross? The blue cross is at (42,48): horizontal arm is row 42, columns 37-59; vertical arm is column 48, rows 31-53. X at (45,27) moving DOWN to (48,27): X's right diagonal arm: (48+k, 27+k) k=0..11 → (48,27)...(59,38). Blue cross's vertical arm is column 48, rows 31-53: X's arm at column 48? X's arm column = 27+k = 48 → k=21 > 11, doesn't apply. Horizontal: X's row 48+k... blue's horizontal arm is row 42: X's arm row 42? X is at (48,27): arm (48-k,27±k): row 42 → k=6 → (42,33) and (42,21). Blue's horizontal arm is row 42, columns 37-59: (42,33) is not included (33<37). Hmm, no overlap.
So why did it stop at 8? Maybe the batch actually executed all 13 actions, but the history display is truncated to 8 (the "first 10" should show 10). It says "first 10" but only 8 are listed. Strange. And W is at (45,27) — if SPACE had been executed, W should have moved to the blue cross's center (42,48) or the diamond's (30,38). W is at (45,27) = X's center. So SPACE was not executed, and LEFT wasn't either (X's column is still 27).
So only 8 DOWNs were executed. The 9th DOWN may have been rejected (board unchanged?) — maybe X at (48,27) would overlap with the blue dot's frame at (48,33)? X at (48,27): arm (48+k,27+k): k=6 → (54,33)? No. Arm (48-k,27+k): k=6 → (42,33) — the blue dot frame at (48,33) spans rows 47-49, columns 32-34. (42,33) is not inside it. Arm (48+k,27-k): k=... column 33 → k=-6, doesn't apply.
Hmm, what about the blue dot frame at (48,15)? X at (48,27): arm (48-k,27-k): k=12>11, doesn't apply.
Or the 9th DOWN was blocked because X's arm would overlap with the blue cross's pixels: X at (48,27)'s arm: right-down (48+k,27+k) k≤11 → max column 38; blue cross's minimum column is 37 (horizontal arm row 42, columns 37-59). X's arm (48+k,27+k) at row 42? k would be -6, doesn't apply. So no.
Actually, the batch may have been cut off due to a timeout (30 seconds) — 13 actions in one call, each action is about 1-2 seconds... 8 actions completed before the timeout? Possible. The tool returned normally, but the environment may have only processed part of it.
Current state: X is at (45,27), still active (W is there). Need 1 more DOWN → (48,27), then 3 LEFT → (48,18). Let me execute these 4 actions and verify.
